steps.description: Binary search columns [0..2]. Each column's own row-max already beats its row neighbors — only its column neighbors can still beat it.
Column 1's max is -13 at row 1. Left neighbor = 47, right neighbor = -37.
The left neighbor (47) is bigger — a peak provably exists to the left.
Column 0's max is 47 at row 1. Left neighbor = none, right neighbor = -13.
47 beats both column neighbors (and its own row) — a confirmed 2D peak at (1, 0).
